Plan.title: Plan
Plan.free: Free — you listen in High quality.
Plan.freeQuality: The whole catalog, no ads and no skip limits. Lossless and Hi-Res are in Premium — during the beta through promo codes.
Plan.premiumQuality: The player picks Lossless or Hi-Res when a track has it and your device can play it.
